acknowledged.note: Notion's current document describes `data_sources/{id}/query`, which replaced this path, and it publishes one document rather than one per version. The path is still live on the real API under a version older than 2025-09-03 -- the deprecation note on the vendor's own page for it reads "This page describes the API for versions up to and including 2022-06-28" -- and that is when Backlot serves it: a request under 2025-09-03 or later is refused here with `invalid_request_url`, the way the real API refuses it. Read off the document on 2026-09-01, versions re-read on 2026-09-15.
